name: pi-persona
description: A character persona for pi's voice, over engineering that does not change. chara_card_v2 cards from chub.ai or disk, extracted into a voice profile and prepended to the system prompt.
author: coffeegrind123

scripts.lint: for file in extensions/index.ts src/*.ts tests/*.ts; do node --check "$file" 2>/dev/null || node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings -e "import('./$file').catch(e => { if (e.code === 'ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND') process.exit(0); console.error('$file:', e.message); process.exit(1) })"; done
